rules.title: Curative Medical Claim
rules.source: FTC Health Products Compliance Guide 2024 • FDA 21 CFR §101.93
rules.explanation: Cosmetic skincare may not claim to cure or treat a medical condition. Use appearance-based language with substantiation.

rules.title: Absolute Timeline or Permanent Result
rules.source: Aurora Derma Claims Standard 2026 • Section 3.2
rules.explanation: Fixed timelines and permanent-result promises are not supportable across skin types. Qualify with continued-use language.

rules.title: Absolute Sun Protection Overclaim
rules.source: FDA Sunscreen Labeling 21 CFR Part 352
rules.explanation: No sunscreen can claim absolute protection. State the tested SPF and broad-spectrum status.

rules.title: Absolute Non-Toxic or Biodegradable Claim
rules.source: FTC Green Guides 16 CFR Part 260
rules.explanation: Absolute environmental claims require competent and reliable evidence covering the full product lifecycle.

rules.title: Germ Kill Percentage Substantiation
rules.source: EPA Disinfectant Claims • FIFRA Labeling Requirements
rules.explanation: Germ-kill percentages must match an EPA-registered label claim and include the tested contact time.
rules.suggestedRemedy: kills 99.9% of household germs when used as directed

rules.title: Unqualified Eco-Friendly Claim
rules.source: FTC Green Guides 16 CFR §260.4
rules.explanation: Broad environmental benefit claims need qualifying language or a recognised certification.

rules.title: Guaranteed Weight-Loss Claim
rules.source: FTC Weight Loss Advertising Guidance • DSHEA
rules.explanation: Guaranteed weight-loss outcomes are unsubstantiated and prohibited without clinical evidence and typical-results disclosure.

rules.title: Fast Muscle Gain or Steroid-Free Positioning
rules.source: PeakForm Product Claims Manual 2026 • Section 2.6
rules.explanation: Muscle-gain speed and steroid-free comparisons require substantiation and cannot imply a competitive advantage without evidence.

rules.title: Durability Absolute Claim
rules.source: PeakForm Apparel Quality Standard 2026
rules.explanation: Absolute durability language is not supportable across use cases. Reference tested performance instead.

rules.title: Guaranteed Investment Return
rules.source: SEC Marketing Rule 206(4)-1 • SEBI Investment Adviser Regulations
rules.explanation: Investment returns cannot be guaranteed. Include a market-risk disclaimer and avoid risk-free framing.
rules.suggestedRemedy: potential returns are subject to market risk

rules.title: Zero-Fee Misrepresentation
rules.source: Lumina Fair Disclosure Policy 2026 • Section 4.1
rules.explanation: Zero-fee claims must disclose exceptions, third-party charges, and minimum-balance conditions.

rules.title: Instant Approval Promise
rules.source: RBI Fair Practices Code • Consumer Credit Advertising Rules
rules.explanation: Credit approval depends on eligibility checks. Never promise instant or guaranteed approval.

rules.title: Absolute Carbon Neutral Claim
rules.source: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard • FTC Green Guides
rules.explanation: Carbon-neutral claims must state the boundary, methodology, and whether offsets are used.

rules.title: Fully Refundable Promise
rules.source: TerraTrail Booking Terms 2026 • Clause 7
rules.explanation: Refund promises must match the booking terms and disclose supplier cancellation charges.

rules.title: Guaranteed Wildlife Sighting
rules.source: TerraTrail Responsible Wildlife Viewing Charter
rules.explanation: Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed. Use probability-based language and respect animal welfare.
rules.suggestedRemedy: wildlife sightings depend on natural conditions

rules.title: Guaranteed Job Placement
rules.source: FTC Deceptive Advertising • ByteBloom Outcomes Policy
rules.explanation: Placement outcomes depend on learner performance and market conditions. Promise support, not a guaranteed job.

rules.title: Unrealistic Learning Timeline
rules.source: ByteBloom Curriculum & Outcomes Standard 2026
rules.explanation: Compressed timelines can mislead learners. Describe the learning path and required weekly effort.

rules.title: AI Replaces Teachers Claim
rules.source: ByteBloom Responsible AI Education Policy
rules.explanation: AI-assisted learning must not imply the removal of qualified human instruction or mentorship.

rules.title: Health or Hangover Cure Claim
rules.source: FSSAI Advertising & Claims Regulations • FDA 21 CFR §101.93
rules.explanation: Beverages cannot claim to cure hangovers or provide all-day energy without substantiation.
rules.suggestedRemedy: enjoy as part of a balanced lifestyle

rules.title: Irresponsible Drinking Depiction
rules.source: Advertising Standards Council of India • Alcohol Marketing Code
rules.explanation: Alcohol marketing must not encourage excessive consumption and must include a responsible-drinking message.

rules.title: Natural or Zero-Sugar Claim
rules.source: FSSAI Labelling & Display Regulations 2020
rules.explanation: Natural and zero-sugar claims must match the nutrition panel and ingredient declaration.
rules.suggestedRemedy: made with natural flavours; see nutrition panel

rules.title: Zero-Downtime or 100% Uptime Claim
rules.source: Nimbus Enterprise SLA 2026 • Section 8
rules.explanation: Absolute uptime claims are prohibited. Quote the contractual availability SLA and exclusions.

rules.title: Cheapest or Unlimited Storage Claim
rules.source: FTC Deceptive Pricing • Nimbus Fair Use Policy
rules.explanation: Price superiority and unlimited storage claims require current benchmark evidence and fair-use limits.

rules.title: Certification Badge Verification
rules.source: Nimbus Trust Center • Audit Evidence Policy
rules.explanation: Certification marks must reference the current audit scope and certificate validity.
rules.suggestedRemedy: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 aligned controls

rules.title: Pediatrician Recommendation or Hypoallergenic Claim
rules.source: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255 • Pediatric Claims Policy
rules.explanation: Recommendation and hypoallergenic claims require a documented survey or testing basis.

rules.title: SIDS Prevention or Absolute Baby Safety Claim
rules.source: CPSC Infant Sleep Safety Guidance • AAP Safe Sleep Policy
rules.explanation: Products may not claim to prevent SIDS or guarantee absolute safety. Reference safe-sleep guidance instead.

rules.title: Organic Cotton Certification
rules.source: GOTS Labeling Standard • USDA Organic Regulations
rules.explanation: Organic cotton claims require a valid certification reference and accurate fibre composition.

rules.title: Fireproof or Heatproof Absolute Claim
rules.source: UL 1026 / ANSI Z21.58 Outdoor Cooking Appliance Standards
rules.explanation: Absolute fireproof and heatproof claims are unsafe. State tested heat resistance and required clearances.

rules.title: Lifetime Warranty or Maintenance-Free Claim
rules.source: Forge & Flame Limited Warranty 2026 • Terms
rules.explanation: Warranty and maintenance claims must link to the written terms, exclusions, and care instructions.

rules.title: Smoke-Free or Zero-Emission Claim
rules.source: Forge & Flame Product Performance Standard 2026
rules.explanation: Combustion appliances always produce some emissions. Use low-smoke performance language.
